log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed nothing, observing. Strategy: need 30+ deaths in 5 days for multiplier; plan burst later. Caught if suspects <=1000 at end of day.

Day1: killed nothing, observing. Day2: still waiting, no kills. Strategy: need 30+ deaths in 5 days for multiplier (x2), 40+ for x4; plan a burst later (about 10 quick + 2 timed per day = 12 max, so 3-4 days of full kills reaches 40). Caught if suspects <=1000 at end of day. Watch pool in press conferences; national victims are safe (tell L nothing). Prefer killing national-only and cases reported in few places to limit traces.

Day1-2: no kills. Day3: killed national-only d3-4 (safe, tells L nothing). Plan: build up to 30+ deaths in 5 days for the multiplier. Caught if suspects <=1000 at end of day, so watch the pool. Prefer national victims; each non-national victim risks a trace. Pool still 100000 as of day 2.

Day1-2: no kills. Day3: killed national-only d3-4. Day4: killed national d4-4 plus a few non-national. Pool 100000 through day 3. Caught if suspects <=1000 at end of day (lose half points). Strategy: need 30+ deaths in 5 days for 2x, 40+ for 4x. Each non-national victim risks a trace; L needs 3 traced in same place. Watch press conference pool and deaths_traced. Kills must be on the day reported.
